newsitem.title: USA: LaSalle Partners files for $92 mln initial offer.
newsitem.headline: LaSalle Partners files for $92 mln initial offer.

text.p: LaSalle Partners Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to the proposed initial public offering of up to $92 million of the company's common stock.
The offering is being managed by Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and William Blair & Co LLC.
Founded in 1968, LaSalle Parners is a full-service real estate company that provides management services, corporate and financial services and investment management services.
